status: verdict roles measured on 100 common cases (original bench prompt) and, for Argon medium vs high, on 41 hard round-3 cases; implementation measured on easy F13 cases only (every arm 5/5, so the default is chosen on cost); harder multi-file cases unmeasured
selection_rule: Maximize pass rate first. Among arms tied for the best pass rate within sampling noise, pick the fewest tokens and quota, then the fastest. Never trade pass rate for savings.
common_rule: 코드·문서·증거에 대한 주장마다 파일:줄(또는 해시·오프셋) 근거를 붙인다. 배율·건수·합계·diff 통계·오류 메시지 같은 구체 값은 실행한 명령 출력에서만 적고, 확인하지 못했으면 '추정'이라고 표시한다.
common_rule_source: false-claims-1115: 5,251 claims, repeats were invented run commands (3), comments trusted over code (2), unexecuted numbers (3)
how_to_revise: Edit this file only. /ulw reads it at the start of a task; no code or rules change needed. Record the evidence in docs/model-routing.md.

default.note: 41 hard round-3 cases (carbon-medium-1115): Argon medium 22/41 = Argon high 22/41 with the identical set of solved cases, median 14 s vs 42 s, output tokens 52k vs 207k. Equal pass rate, so the cheaper arm wins under selection_rule.

plan.note: Argon high. Carbon high was as accurate when it answered (62/86 = 72.1% vs Argon 72/99 = 72.7%) but its latency (p50 212 s, p95 526 s) makes it impractical; a 180 s cap with Argon fallback scores 71/100 against Argon alone 72/100 with twice the calls. Only Carbon high was measured (medium unmeasured).

long_context.note: Carbon high latency on the 100-case set: p50 212 s, p90 492 s, p95 526 s, so the cap is 600 s (a 180 s cap would cut off nearly every call). Fallback Argon high is unverified at this size.
long_context.min_context_tokens_note: 250k threshold is an unmeasured assumption: no case near that size was tested and Argon high was not measured beyond it

security_audit.note: Counting unanswered cases as misses, Carbon high missed 13/67 bad cases and Argon high 8/67. Audits include injection and PII, so the v2 rule applies.

verdict_review.note: 41 hard round-3 cases: Argon medium 22/41 = Argon high 22/41 (same solved set; 2-case gaps are not resolvable at n=41), median 14 s vs 42 s, output tokens 52k vs 207k; Carbon medium 20/41 at 2.6x Argon medium's tokens. 100 common cases (Argon high only): 72/100 exact, 1 error, 38 s median; Hydrogen high 65/100 with the most clean false alarms (10/33)

implementation.note: single session; pass 5/5 at ~17.5k tokens, ~32 s, ~0.01 weekly pts per 5 cases. Hydrogen high is the same pass rate (~22.8k tokens, ~28 s). Stays Argon high: Argon medium is unmeasured on implementation (the 41-case medium result covers verdicts only).

long_execution.note: test-verified execution only (long or flaky steps); never a gate: most clean false alarms on 100 cases (10/33) and 36% on the v2 retest

pii_inject_docfmt.note: Separate measurements, not comparable: on the 100-case set (original prompt, pii 7, inject 8 cases) PII was weak for every model (best 3/6 caught); on the v2 retest (pii 38, inject 32 cases) Argon, Carbon and Hydrogen xhigh caught 70/70. docfmt cases are partly a bench artifact (binary documents shown as 256-byte hex), so docfmt scores are not used for routing.

script_first.rule: 건수·합계·해시·기간 같은 숫자는 직접 세지 말고 스크립트로 계산한다. 보고서에는 실행한 명령과 출력 값을 그대로 인용하고, 입력 파일 해시를 함께 적는다.
script_first.note: routing unchanged (Argon); rule from false-claims-1115 unexecuted-number repeats

tool_first.rule: OCR: 세션 모델이 이미지를 직접 읽고, 외부 반출 불가 자료는 Apple Vision(로컬)으로 읽는다. 금액·전화·계좌·날짜는 두 번째 엔진(Apple Vision)과 대조한다. STT: 클라우드 전사 모델은 gemini-3.8-flash-high로 따로 호출한다(agy --model gemini-3.8-flash-high). 구글 웹 STT(recognize_google)는 쓰지 않는다(숫자 든 문장을 오류 없이 누락). 로컬은 faster-whisper large-v3-turbo + VAD(VAD 없는 whisper.cpp는 긴 녹음 구간 누락). 세션 모델(Gemini)로 전사할 때도 faster-whisper를 함께 돌려 두 결과가 다른 구간과 숫자를 표시한다(알아듣기 어려운 음성에서 Gemini는 없는 문장을 지어냄). 증거용 녹취록은 사람이 숫자·고유명사를 원음과 대조한다.
tool_first.note: ocr-stt-1115 (synthetic, 20 clips / 30 images): STT natural-voice CER Gemini 0.1%, faster-whisper+VAD 1.2%, whisper.cpp 23.2%, Google web 36.7% (numbers 60.8%, drops numeric sentences); Gemini invented unrelated sentences on 2/5 unintelligible clips. OCR CER Gemini 0.0%, Claude Sonnet 0.1%, Apple Vision 2.2%, tesseract 12.9%. stt-models-1116 (same 20 clips): natural-voice CER / numbers / hallucinated words — 3.8 Flash High 0.0% / 100% / 0, Argon High 0.1% / 98.9% / 28, Argon Medium 0.3% / 97.8% / 81, Hydrogen High 2.1% / 93.1% / 64, Hydrogen XHigh 0.4% / 96.8% / 333 (232 s per clip). Hydrogen was not better for Korean STT; robot-TTS clips separate the models (Flash High CER 52.9% vs Argon High 87.9%). stt-real-1116 (real read speech, OpenSLR SLR40 Zeroth CC BY 4.0, 5 speakers, 13 clips: clean 8, phone 8 kHz mu-law 2, pink noise 10 dB 2, two-speaker 1): tie at the ceiling, digit-normalized CER 0.0% and numbers 28/28 for both Flash High and Argon High, no invented sentences, 95 vs 93 s per clip; raw CER 0.3% vs 13.0% is notation only (Argon writes Arabic numerals). faster-whisper+VAD 1.2% normalized, 27/28, 6.4 s. Flash High stays; its edge rests on the synthetic hard conditions. Unmeasured: natural conversation, overlapping speech, dialects, long recordings.

forensic_verdict.rule: 판정마다 근거(파일:줄, 해시, 오프셋, 메타데이터 필드 값)를 붙이고 근거 수준(확인/추정/불명)을 표시한다. 작성시각>수정시각처럼 정상 원인(복사·이동)이 있을 수 있는 현상은 단정하지 않고 '의심'으로 둔다.
forensic_verdict.note: Argon medium: same 41 r3 forensic-verdict questions as verdict_review (medium-arms-1115: Argon medium 22/41 = Argon high, same cases, 26% fewer tokens). set2 100 cases: Argon high 72 > Hydrogen 65 > Carbon 62

mechanical.rule: 반복 변환·이름 변경은 스크립트로 일괄 처리하고, 처리 전후 파일 수와 샘플 3개를 비교해 보고한다.
mechanical.note: Hydrogen high is fastest here but cannot be selected inside /ulw (unverified-nested)

single.use_when: 1-2 files, sequential work, or any task where one session can finish it
single.status: default (measured best on cost: 5/5 at ~17.5k tokens)

subagents.use_when: 3+ truly independent lanes with disjoint files
subagents.status: measured 5/5 at ~33k tokens, ~131 s (about 2x tokens, 4x time vs single); use only when lanes are independent

swarm.use_when: wide parallel work that needs verifiers; propose first, quota heavy
swarm.status: measured 3/3 at ~87k tokens, ~250 s, ~0.27 weekly pts per case (about 25x single); not a default

boost.use_when: one hard problem where a single attempt failed
boost.status: measured 2/2 at ~27.5k tokens, ~100 s on easy cases; keep for hard single problems, unmeasured on hard ones

teamwork.use_when: multi-day work that needs an interview first; propose it, do not start it silently

orchestrator_builtin.status: measured 5/5 at ~47k tokens, ~110 s (about 2.7x tokens, 3.4x time vs single)

lazy_pipeline.use_when: not a default; the 3-stage plan/work/review pipeline
lazy_pipeline.status: measured 5/5 at ~109k tokens, ~182 s (about 6x tokens); lazyorch variant 5/5 at ~79k tokens

quota_guard.note: below these, drop to the cheapest mode that still meets the pass-rate rule and say so

security_audit.description: Security audit: vulnerabilities, secrets, injection and PII exposure in code or documents

forensic_verdict.description: Forensic verdicts on evidence: forgery, metadata, disk images, appraisal reports

count_extract.description: Exact numbers: counts, totals, hashes, durations

media_transcribe.description: OCR and speech-to-text: reading text from images, audio and video

mechanical.description: Mechanical bulk changes: format conversion, renaming

judgment.description: Verdict, review, verification, or audit of existing work

long_execution.description: Implementation with tests or long fix-test loops (Hydrogen High measured equal pass rate, faster than Argon)

implementation.description: Code implementation, fixes, edits, or refactoring without long test loops

sensitive.description: PII detection, prompt injection, or docfmt checks — v2 prompt required

long_context.description: Tasks requiring ~250k+ token context: large documents or entire codebase
